label: Booking Confirmed
description: The LEAD'S side of a booked meeting: a scheduling page's confirmation in a neutral, Cal-style card -- a green check pops, 'This meeting is scheduled', the invitation line, then What / When / Who / Where rows land one by one, with an optional plain timestamp under the card ('BOOKED TUESDAY, 11:02 PM'). The 'someone books a demo' beat of a lifecycle or automation film; cut from it to the flow that researches the person. Laid out on a 1440-wide design stage at the box's aspect, scaled to the box: give it the full frame or a large box.

subtitle.label: Line under the title ('' for none; default the invitation line)

rows.label: Rows (label + value; a newline in a value breaks it)

avatars.label: Photos, one per line of the value (a face beside each name; '' for none)

stamp.label: Plain timestamp under the card (uppercase grey type, no box)

still.label: The card is there from the first frame (the check and rows still play)
